description: Tamura-class hall current measurement: true phase current with offset + quantization to LSB and clamp (saturates to range; post-fault rails behavior lives in Plant.Fault.Point injection). Matches the recorded 0.07 A/LSB quantization at ±1200 A range.

inputPorts.name: Rail
inputPorts.description: >=0.5 emits the recorded isolated-rail-collapse artifact value (RailVal_A) verbatim, bypassing quantization and the range clamp.

RailVal_A.description: Post rail-collapse artifact readout, A (recorded per-channel: U=+1390, V=-1250, W=+1180); emitted verbatim when Rail >= 0.5.
